MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

2. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 9
   C. 18
   D. 82

3. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/3
   C. 3/4
   D. 1/2

4. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 21
   C. 15
   D. 17

6. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 169
   C. 26
   D. 13

7. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 12

8. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 4
   C. 33
   D. 32

9. Solve for x: x + 8 = 20. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 20
   C. 13
   D. 12

10. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 7
   C. 49
   D. 14

11. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 41
   C. 40
   D. 3

12. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 22

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
